But here they come, the little beauties, and what are they carrying? Steps to the throne, carpet and seat, curtain and canopy richly embroidered, wave upon wave, like cloudy wreaths, it flows on high over the queenly head, for already invited, she has mounted the throne’s cushioned seat. Come! Move forward! Range yourselves in rows on each step. Worthy, worthy, oh three-times worthy the dignity of so blest a reception! (Everything described by the CHORUS occurs in sequence. After the long procession of PAGES and SQUIRES has descended, 浮士德, dressed as a medieval courtier, appears at the head of the stairs and comes down with slow dignity.)

@@U03740@@
(Observing him attentively.)

@@U03741@@
Unless the gods, as so often they do, have lent this man for a short time only his admirable figure, his stately bearing, and loving presence, then he will succeed in all he undertakes, whether battles of men or that lesser skirmish with the loveliest women. I have seen other men most highly esteemed, but there can be no question that he takes preference. I see the Prince approach her now, solemnly, with slow reverent step. Turn now, great Queen, and face him!
translation:
@@U03738@@
可小美女们来了，她们带着什么呢？走向王座的台阶，地毯和座位，窗帘和华盖都绣着华丽的图案，一波又一波，像云朵花环，高高地飘过女王的头顶，因为她已经受到邀请，已经登上了王座的软垫座位。来！前进！每一步都排成一排。值得，值得，哦，三倍值得如此幸福的接待的尊严！ （合唱团所描述的一切都是按顺序发生的。侍从和侍从的长队下来后，打扮成中世纪朝臣的浮士德出现在楼梯口，缓慢而庄严地走下来。）

@@U03740@@
（仔细观察他。）

@@U03741@@
除非诸神像经常做的那样，在短时间内只借给这个男人令人钦佩的身材、庄严的举止和慈爱的存在，那么他将在他所从事的一切事情中取得成功，无论是男人的战斗还是与最可爱的女人的小冲突。我见过其他最受尊敬的人，但毫无疑问他更受尊敬。我看到王子现在庄严地走近她，步伐缓慢而虔诚。现在转身，伟大的女王，面对他！
